title: Incidence open models for a restricted fppf-relation quotient
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $R,U,U'$ be $S$-schemes, and let $j=(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product] identify $R(T)$ with an equivalence relation on $U(T)$ for every $S$-scheme $T$. Assume $s,t$ are surjective, flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and $g:U'\to U$ is flat and locally of finite presentation, without a surjectivity assumption. Set $R'=U'\times_{g,U,s}R\times_{t,U,g}U'$. On $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] let $F$ and $F'$ be the sheafifications [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the pointwise quotient presheaves $U(-)/R(-)$ and $U'(-)/R'(-)$, and let $\alpha:F'\to F$ be their canonical map. Assume $\alpha_T:F'(T)\to F(T)$ is injective for every $T$. Write $h_X(T)=\operatorname{Mor}_S(T,X)$ for a representable functor, $q:h_U\to F$ for the quotient map, $E=U'\times_{g,U,s}R$, and $p=t\circ\operatorname{pr}_R:E\to U$. Then $p$ is flat and locally of finite presentation, its set-theoretic image $W=p(E)$ is open in $U$, and its factor $E\to W$, with $W$ given its open subscheme structure [def-weil-open-immersion], is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation. For every $S$-morphism $v:V\to U$, put $W_V=v^{-1}(W)$. There is a natural isomorphism over $h_V$, $h_{W_V}\simeq h_V\times_{F,q\circ h_v,\alpha}F'$. These isomorphisms commute with pullback along every $V_1\to V$ over $U$.

proof.text: The projection $\operatorname{pr}_R:E=U'\times_U R\to R$ is the base change of $g$ along $s$. By [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change] and clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] it is flat and locally of finite presentation. Apply [lem-pc-flat-compose] and [lem-sbc-locally-finite-presentation-composition] to this projection followed by $t$: the resulting $p:E\to U$ is flat and locally of finite presentation. Neither application uses surjectivity of $g$, quasi-compactness, or quasi-separatedness; only the local-finite-presentation part of clause (3) is used.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), incidence open image and last two paragraphs, specialized to a lift V to U

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-flat-lfp-open], $W=p(E)$ is open. Give it its open subscheme structure. By [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme] there is a unique $p_W:E\to W$ with inclusion followed after $p_W$ equal to $p$. The square with top arrow $1_E$, bottom arrow $W\hookrightarrow U$ and vertical arrows $p_W,p$ is Cartesian: a pair of maps to $E$ and $W$ with the same image in $U$ has its $W$ coordinate uniquely determined by its $E$ coordinate, using the uniqueness in the same factorization lemma. Thus $p_W$ is a base change of $p$ and is flat and locally of finite presentation by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change] and [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3). It is surjective by the definition of $W$. Consequently $\{p_W:E\to W\}$ is an fppf covering by [def-pc-fppf-site].

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), incidence open image and last two paragraphs, specialized to a lift V to U

proof.text: For the big fppf topology over S, the range of a monomorphic map between sheaves is a sheaf: Subfunctor.toRange is an isomorphism, and Subfunctor.eq_sheafify then says local image membership is actual image membership. A morphism whose singleton sieve covers induces a locally surjective Yoneda map by stability under pullback. Apply this to E → W. The relation coequalizer equation and hα imply α q'(b)=q(p); hence q(W → U) is locally in the image of α, and the closed-range observation gives its unique preimage zW. By Yoneda this defines βW and its commuting square.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), incidence open image and last two paragraphs, specialized to a lift V to U

proof.text: The universal property hη' implies that η' is locally surjective even in the stated small value universe. Let H be the subsheaf obtained by locally closing its image in F'. The factorization η':P'→H extends uniquely to l:F'→H. The uniqueness part gives l followed by H→F' equal to the identity; therefore H=F'. This is an elementary image-subsheaf proof of local representability from the given sheafification property. The coequalizer projection is sectionwise surjective (evaluation preserves coequalizers, which are epimorphisms of types). Composition shows q' locally surjective.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), incidence open image and last two paragraphs, specialized to a lift V to U

proof.text: Given a:T→U and z in F'(T) with q(a)=α(z), take the covering image sieve of z under q'. For each f:Z→T in this sieve choose c:Z→U' with q'(c)=z|Z. Naturality and hα give q(gc)=q(af). Apply [lem-trf-etale-relation-kernel-pair] sectionwise to obtain d:Z→R with sd=gc and td=af. The pullback universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] yields ce:Z→E. Thus af=ce p factors through W. The sieve of local lifts of a to h_W is covering.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), incidence open image and last two paragraphs, specialized to a lift V to U

proof.text: The representables h_W and h_U are fppf sheaves by subcanonicity (also on Over S), and h_W→h_U is monomorphic. Apply the closed-range observation to the covering sieve from the preceding step to obtain the unique l:T→W with li=a. Its βW image equals z because their α-images equal q(a). This proves the universal lifting property of the sheaf pullback; monicity of h_W→h_U gives uniqueness. Test-objectwise pullbacks are presheaf pullbacks.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), incidence open image and last two paragraphs, specialized to a lift V to U

proof.text: For v:V→U form the usual restriction map v⁻¹(W)→W. The square with the two open inclusions is Cartesian in schemes and therefore in Over S. Apply the limit-preserving Yoneda functor and paste with the pullback h_W→h_U of α. Set β(V,v) to the restriction map followed by βW. For k:V1→V and kW as in the statement, the two maps to W agree after composition with its monomorphic inclusion in U; cancel this inclusion. Functoriality of Yoneda and composition with βW give the displayed naturality equation.

The proof is correct. Step 1: pr_R is the base change of g along s, so it is flat (Flat.isStableUnderBaseChange) and locally of finite presentation (qcqs-permanence clause (3), which has no qcqs hypothesis), and it is then composed with t. Step 2: W=p(E) is open by UniversallyOpen.of_flat. The square for E->W is Cartesian because W->U is a monomorphism, so {E->W} is an fppf covering. Steps 3-4: the covering T x_W E is pulled back, then the sheaf equalizer and injectivity of alpha give a unique lift z_T. Step 5: local representatives of the sheafification (accepted tool_use of lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local, a generic 00WB/00WK result from unit sk-thm-p1) plus the same-unit kernel-pair node, which needs only a monomorphic equivalence relation, give the maps r_i. Steps 6-7: joint surjectivity of the covering gives va(T) in W, the factorization through W is unique, and naturality and base change along V1->V are checked on sections. Hypotheses match 02WU and the parent lem-trf-etale-relation-finding-opens: g is not assumed surjective, and injectivity of alpha is an assumption here because the parent's Step 2 proves it. The item is a strict sub-lemma, not a restatement of the parent. Not superseded: live and side-live are unsplit. No repair note, no dropped entry, no cycle, no SGA.
